notes: the report has five «ح» branches, each written with its own teacher; each is a group
«كل هؤلاء عن يحيى بن سعيد» closes only the last branch (Abd al-Wahhab, Yahya b. Sa'id, Hafs b. Ghiyath), so Yahya b. Sa'id is its last link; the other branches are not extended by it
«بمعنى حديث زهير» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group; the later remark about Ibn Ramh's wording is a wording variant and is left out
«يعني ابن زيد» is a gloss and is left out
